<dd>
<p>Build the parts used in the last summary stats line.</p>
<p>The summary stats line is the line shown at the end, “=== 12 passed, 2 errors in Xs===”.</p>
<p>This function builds a list of the “parts” that make up for the text in that line, in
the example above it would be:</p>
<div class="highlight-default notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
<span class="p">[</span>
    <span class="p">(</span>
<span class="s2">"12 passed"</span>
<span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">{</span>
<span class="s2">"green"</span>
<span class="p">:</span> <span class="kc">True</span>
<span class="p">}),</span>
    <span class="p">(</span>
<span class="s2">"2 errors"</span>
<span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">{</span>
<span class="s2">"red"</span>
<span class="p">:</span> <span class="kc">True</span>
<span class="p">}</span>
<span class="p">]</span>
</pre>
</div>
</div>
<p>That last dict for each line is a “markup dictionary”, used by TerminalWriter to
color output.</p>
<p>The final color of the line is also determined by this function, and is the second
element of the returned tuple.</p>

<section id="stash">
<h3>
Stash
<a class="headerlink" href="#stash" title="Link to this heading">¶</a>
</h3>
<dl class="py class">
<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="pytest.Stash">
<span class="property">
<span class="k">
<span class="pre">class</span>
</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
</span>
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">Stash</span>
</span>
<a class="reference internal" href="../_modules/_pytest/stash.html#Stash">
<span class="viewcode-link">
<span class="pre">[source]</span>
</span>
</a>
<a class="headerlink" href="#pytest.Stash" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">Stash</span>
</code>
 is a type-safe heterogeneous mutable mapping that
allows keys and value types to be defined separately from
where it (the 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">Stash</span>
</code>
) is created.
</p>
<p>
Usually you will be given an object which has a 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">Stash</span>
</code>
, for example

<a class="reference internal" href="#pytest.Config" title="pytest.Config">
<code class="xref py py-class docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">Config</span>
</code>
</a>
 or a 
<a class="reference internal" href="#pytest.nodes.Node" title="_pytest.nodes.Node">
<code class="xref py py-class docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">Node</span>
</code>
</a>
:
</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
<span class="n">stash</span>
<span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">Stash</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">some_object</span>
<span class="o">.</span>
<span class="n">stash</span>
</pre>
</div>
</div>
<p>
If a module or plugin wants to store data in this 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">Stash</span>
</code>
, it creates

<a class="reference internal" href="#pytest.StashKey" title="pytest.StashKey">
<code class="xref py py-class docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">StashKey</span>
</code>
</a>
s for its keys (at the module level):
</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
<span class="c1"># At the top-level of the module</span>
<span class="n">some_str_key</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">StashKey</span>
<span class="p">[</span>
<span class="nb">str</span>
<span class="p">]()</span>
<span class="n">some_bool_key</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">StashKey</span>
<span class="p">[</span>
<span class="nb">bool</span>
<span class="p">]()</span>
</pre>
</div>
</div>
<p>To store information:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
<span class="c1"># Value type must match the key.</span>
<span class="n">stash</span>
<span class="p">[</span>
<span class="n">some_str_key</span>
<span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">"value"</span>
<span class="n">stash</span>
<span class="p">[</span>
<span class="n">some_bool_key</span>
<span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="kc">True</span>
</pre>
</div>
</div>
<p>To retrieve the information:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
<span class="c1"># The static type of some_str is str.</span>
<span class="n">some_str</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">stash</span>
<span class="p">[</span>
<span class="n">some_str_key</span>
<span class="p">]</span>
<span class="c1"># The static type of some_bool is bool.</span>
<span class="n">some_bool</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">stash</span>
<span class="p">[</span>
<span class="n">some_bool_key</span>
<span class="p">]</span>
</pre>
</div>
</div>
<div class="versionadded">
<p>
<span class="versionmodified added">Added in version 7.0.</span>
</p>
</div>

<section id="global-variables">
<h2>
Global Variables
<a class="headerlink" href="#global-variables" title="Link to this heading">¶</a>
</h2>
<p>
pytest treats some global variables in a special manner when defined in a test module or

<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">conftest.py</span>
</code>
 files.
</p>
<dl class="std globalvar">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="globalvar-collect_ignore">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">collect_ignore</span>
</span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#globalvar-collect_ignore" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd></dd>
</dl>

<p>
<strong>Tutorial</strong>
: 
<a class="reference internal" href="../example/pythoncollection.html#customizing-test-collection">
<span class="std std-ref">Customizing test collection</span>
</a>
</p>
<p>
Can be declared in 
<em>conftest.py files</em>
 to exclude test directories or modules.
Needs to be a list of paths (
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">str</span>
</code>
, 
<a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/pathlib.html#pathlib.Path" title="(in Python v3.14)">
<code class="xref py py-class docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">pathlib.Path</span>
</code>
</a>
 or any 
<a class="reference external" href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/os.html#os.PathLike" title="(in Python v3.14)">
<code class="xref py py-class docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">os.PathLike</span>
</code>
</a>
).
</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
<span class="n">collect_ignore</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span>
<span class="s2">"setup.py"</span>
<span class="p">]</span>
</pre>
</div>
</div>
<dl class="std globalvar">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="globalvar-collect_ignore_glob">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">collect_ignore_glob</span>
</span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#globalvar-collect_ignore_glob" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd></dd>
</dl>

<p>
<strong>Tutorial</strong>
: 
<a class="reference internal" href="../example/pythoncollection.html#customizing-test-collection">
<span class="std std-ref">Customizing test collection</span>
</a>
</p>
<p>
Can be declared in 
<em>conftest.py files</em>
 to exclude test directories or modules
with Unix shell-style wildcards. Needs to be 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">list[str]</span>
</code>
 where 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">str</span>
</code>
 can
contain glob patterns.
</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
<span class="n">collect_ignore_glob</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span>
<span class="s2">"*_ignore.py"</span>
<span class="p">]</span>
</pre>
</div>
</div>
<dl class="std globalvar">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="globalvar-pytest_plugins">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">pytest_plugins</span>
</span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#globalvar-pytest_plugins" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd></dd>
</dl>

<p>
<strong>Tutorial</strong>
: 
<a class="reference internal" href="../how-to/plugins.html#available-installable-plugins">
<span class="std std-ref">Requiring/Loading plugins in a test module or conftest file</span>
</a>
</p>
<p>
Can be declared at the 
<strong>global</strong>
 level in 
<em>test modules</em>
 and 
<em>conftest.py files</em>
 to register additional plugins.
Can be either a 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">str</span>
</code>
 or 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">Sequence[str]</span>
</code>
.
</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
<span class="n">pytest_plugins</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">"myapp.testsupport.myplugin"</span>
</pre>
</div>
</div>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
<span class="n">pytest_plugins</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">(</span>
<span class="s2">"myapp.testsupport.tools"</span>
<span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"myapp.testsupport.regression"</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
</pre>
</div>
</div>
<dl class="std globalvar">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="globalvar-pytestmark">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">pytestmark</span>
</span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#globalvar-pytestmark" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd></dd>
</dl>

<p>
<strong>Tutorial</strong>
: 
<a class="reference internal" href="../example/markers.html#scoped-marking">
<span class="std std-ref">Marking whole classes or modules</span>
</a>
</p>
<p>
Can be declared at the 
<strong>global</strong>
 level in 
<em>test modules</em>
 to apply one or more 
<a class="reference internal" href="#marks-ref">
<span class="std std-ref">marks</span>
</a>
 to all
test functions and methods. Can be either a single mark or a list of marks (applied in left-to-right order).
</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
<span class="kn">import</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="nn">pytest</span>

<span class="n">pytestmark</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">pytest</span>
<span class="o">.</span>
<span class="n">mark</span>
<span class="o">.</span>
<span class="n">webtest</span>
</pre>
</div>
</div>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
<span class="kn">import</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="nn">pytest</span>

<span class="n">pytestmark</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span>
<span class="n">pytest</span>
<span class="o">.</span>
<span class="n">mark</span>
<span class="o">.</span>
<span class="n">integration</span>
<span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">pytest</span>
<span class="o">.</span>
<span class="n">mark</span>
<span class="o">.</span>
<span class="n">slow</span>
<span class="p">]</span>
</pre>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="environment-variables">
<h2>
Environment Variables
<a class="headerlink" href="#environment-variables" title="Link to this heading">¶</a>
</h2>
<p>Environment variables that can be used to change pytest’s behavior.</p>
<dl class="std envvar">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="envvar-CI">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">CI</span>
</span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#envvar-CI" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>
When set to a non-empty value, pytest acknowledges that it is running in a CI process. See also 
<a class="reference internal" href="../explanation/ci.html#ci-pipelines">
<span class="std std-ref">CI Pipelines</span>
</a>
.
</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std envvar">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="envvar-BUILD_NUMBER">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">BUILD_NUMBER</span>
</span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#envvar-BUILD_NUMBER" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>
When set to a non-empty value, pytest acknowledges that it is running in a CI process. Alternative to 
<span class="target" id="index-2"></span>
<a class="reference internal" href="#envvar-CI">
<code class="xref std std-envvar docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">CI</span>
</code>
</a>
. See also 
<a class="reference internal" href="../explanation/ci.html#ci-pipelines">
<span class="std std-ref">CI Pipelines</span>
</a>
.
</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std envvar">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="envvar-PYTEST_ADDOPTS">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">PYTEST_ADDOPTS</span>
</span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#envvar-PYTEST_ADDOPTS" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>
This contains a command-line (parsed by the py:mod:
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">shlex</span>
</code>
 module) that will be 
<strong>prepended</strong>
 to the command line given
by the user, see 
<a class="reference internal" href="customize.html#adding-default-options">
<span class="std std-ref">Builtin configuration file options</span>
</a>
 for more information.
</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std envvar">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="envvar-PYTEST_VERSION">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">PYTEST_VERSION</span>
</span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#envvar-PYTEST_VERSION" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>
This environment variable is defined at the start of the pytest session and is undefined afterwards.
It contains the value of 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">pytest.__version__</span>
</code>
, and among other things can be used to easily check if a code is running from within a pytest run.
</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std envvar">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="envvar-PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST</span>
</span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#envvar-PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>
This is not meant to be set by users, but is set by pytest internally with the name of the current test so other
processes can inspect it, see 
<a class="reference internal" href="../example/simple.html#pytest-current-test-env">
<span class="std std-ref">PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST environment variable</span>
</a>
 for more information.
</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std envvar">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="envvar-PYTEST_DEBUG">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">PYTEST_DEBUG</span>
</span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#envvar-PYTEST_DEBUG" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>When set, pytest will print tracing and debug information.</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std envvar">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="envvar-PYTEST_DEBUG_TEMPROOT">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">PYTEST_DEBUG_TEMPROOT</span>
</span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#envvar-PYTEST_DEBUG_TEMPROOT" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>
Root for temporary directories produced by fixtures like 
<a class="reference internal" href="#std-fixture-tmp_path">
<code class="xref std std-fixture docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">tmp_path</span>
</code>
</a>

as discussed in 
<a class="reference internal" href="../how-to/tmp_path.html#temporary-directory-location-and-retention">
<span class="std std-ref">Temporary directory location and retention</span>
</a>
.
</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std envvar">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="envvar-PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD</span>
</span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#envvar-PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>
When set, disables plugin auto-loading through 
<a class="reference external" href="https://packaging.python.org/en/latest/guides/creating-and-discovering-plugins/" title="(in Python Packaging User Guide)">
<span class="xref std std-doc">entry point packaging
metadata</span>
</a>
. Only plugins
explicitly specified in 
<span class="target" id="index-3"></span>
<a class="reference internal" href="#envvar-PYTEST_PLUGINS">
<code class="xref std std-envvar docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">PYTEST_PLUGINS</span>
</code>
</a>
 or with 
<a class="reference internal" href="#cmdoption-p">
<code class="xref std std-option docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">-p</span>
</code>
</a>
 will be loaded.
See also 
<a class="reference internal" href="../how-to/plugins.html#disable-plugin-autoload">
<span class="std std-ref">–disable-plugin-autoload</span>
</a>
.
</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std envvar">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="envvar-PYTEST_PLUGINS">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">PYTEST_PLUGINS</span>
</span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#envvar-PYTEST_PLUGINS" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>Contains comma-separated list of modules that should be loaded as plugins:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
<span class="nb">export</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="nv">PYTEST_PLUGINS</span>
<span class="o">=</span>
mymodule.plugin,xdist

</pre>
</div>
</div>
<p>
See also 
<a class="reference internal" href="#cmdoption-p">
<code class="xref std std-option docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">-p</span>
</code>
</a>
.
</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std envvar">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="envvar-PYTEST_THEME">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">PYTEST_THEME</span>
</span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#envvar-PYTEST_THEME" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>
Sets a 
<a class="reference external" href="https://pygments.org/docs/styles/">pygment style</a>
 to use for the code output.
</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std envvar">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="envvar-PYTEST_THEME_MODE">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">PYTEST_THEME_MODE</span>
</span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#envvar-PYTEST_THEME_MODE" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>
Sets the 
<span class="target" id="index-4"></span>
<a class="reference internal" href="#envvar-PYTEST_THEME">
<code class="xref std std-envvar docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">PYTEST_THEME</span>
</code>
</a>
 to be either 
<em>dark</em>
 or 
<em>light</em>
.
</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std envvar">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="envvar-PY_COLORS">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">PY_COLORS</span>
</span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#envvar-PY_COLORS" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>
When set to 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">1</span>
</code>
, pytest will use color in terminal output.
When set to 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">0</span>
</code>
, pytest will not use color.

<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">PY_COLORS</span>
</code>
 takes precedence over 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">NO_COLOR</span>
</code>
 and 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">FORCE_COLOR</span>
</code>
.
</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std envvar">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="envvar-NO_COLOR">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">NO_COLOR</span>
</span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#envvar-NO_COLOR" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>
When set to a non-empty string (regardless of value), pytest will not use color in terminal output.

<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">PY_COLORS</span>
</code>
 takes precedence over 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">NO_COLOR</span>
</code>
, which takes precedence over 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">FORCE_COLOR</span>
</code>
.
See 
<a class="reference external" href="https://no-color.org/">no-color.org</a>
 for other libraries supporting this community standard.
</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std envvar">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="envvar-FORCE_COLOR">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">FORCE_COLOR</span>
</span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#envvar-FORCE_COLOR" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>
When set to a non-empty string (regardless of value), pytest will use color in terminal output.

<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">PY_COLORS</span>
</code>
 and 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">NO_COLOR</span>
</code>
 take precedence over 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">FORCE_COLOR</span>
</code>
.
</p>
</dd>
</dl>

</section>

<section id="configuration-options">
<span id="ini-options-ref"></span>
<h2>
Configuration Options
<a class="headerlink" href="#configuration-options" title="Link to this heading">¶</a>
</h2>
<p>
Here is a list of builtin configuration options that may be written in a 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">pytest.ini</span>
</code>
 (or 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">.pytest.ini</span>
</code>
),

<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">pyproject.toml</span>
</code>
, 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">tox.ini</span>
</code>
, or 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">setup.cfg</span>
</code>
 file, usually located at the root of your repository.
</p>
<p>
To see each file format in detail, see 
<a class="reference internal" href="customize.html#config-file-formats">
<span class="std std-ref">Configuration file formats</span>
</a>
.
</p>
<div class="admonition warning">
<p class="admonition-title">
Warning
</p>
<p>
Usage of 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">setup.cfg</span>
</code>
 is not recommended except for very simple use cases. 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">.cfg</span>
</code>

files use a different parser than 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">pytest.ini</span>
</code>
 and 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">tox.ini</span>
</code>
 which might cause hard to track
down problems.
When possible, it is recommended to use the latter files, or 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">pytest.toml</span>
</code>
 or 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">pyproject.toml</span>
</code>
, to hold your pytest configuration.
</p>
</div>
<p>
Configuration options may be overwritten in the command-line by using 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">-o/--override-ini</span>
</code>
, which can also be
passed multiple times. The expected format is 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">name=value</span>
</code>
. For example:
</p>
<div class="highlight-default notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
<span class="n">pytest</span> <span class="o">-</span>
<span class="n">o</span> <span class="n">console_output_style</span>
<span class="o">=</span>
<span class="n">classic</span> <span class="o">-</span>
<span class="n">o</span> <span class="n">cache_dir</span>
<span class="o">=/</span>
<span class="n">tmp</span>
<span class="o">/</span>
<span class="n">mycache</span>
</pre>
</div>
</div>
<dl class="std confval">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="confval-addopts">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">addopts</span>
</span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#confval-addopts" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<dl class="field-list">
<dt class="field-odd">
Type
<span class="colon">:</span>
</dt>
<dd class="field-odd">
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">list[str]</span>
</code>
</dd>
</dl>
<p>
Add the specified 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">OPTS</span>
</code>
 to the set of command line arguments as if they
had been specified by the user. Example: if you have this configuration file content:
</p>
<div class="highlight-toml notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
<span class="c1"># content of pytest.toml</span>
<span class="k">[pytest]</span>
<span class="n">addopts</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="o">=</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="p">[</span>
<span class="s2">"--maxfail=2"</span>
<span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="s2">"-rf"</span>
<span class="p">]</span>
<span class="w">  </span>
<span class="c1"># exit after 2 failures, report fail info</span>
</pre>
</div>
</div>
<p>
issuing 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">pytest</span> <span class="pre">test_hello.py</span>
</code>
 actually means:
</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
pytest
<span class="w"> </span>
--maxfail
<span class="o">=</span>
<span class="m">2</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
-rf
<span class="w"> </span>
test_hello.py

</pre>
</div>
</div>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std confval">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="confval-cache_dir">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">cache_dir</span>
</span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#confval-cache_dir" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<dl class="field-list">
<dt class="field-odd">
Type
<span class="colon">:</span>
</dt>
<dd class="field-odd">
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">str</span>
</code>
</dd>
<dt class="field-even">
Default
<span class="colon">:</span>
</dt>
<dd class="field-even">
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">".pytest_cache"</span>
</code>
</dd>
</dl>
<p>
Sets the directory where the cache plugin’s content is stored.
Directory may be relative or absolute path. If setting relative path, then directory is created
relative to 
<a class="reference internal" href="customize.html#rootdir">
<span class="std std-ref">rootdir</span>
</a>
. Additionally, a path may contain environment
variables, that will be expanded. For more information about cache plugin
please refer to 
<a class="reference internal" href="../how-to/cache.html#cache-provider">
<span class="std std-ref">How to re-run failed tests and maintain state between test runs</span>
</a>
.
</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std confval">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="confval-collect_imported_tests">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">collect_imported_tests</span>
</span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#confval-collect_imported_tests" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<dl class="field-list">
<dt class="field-odd">
Type
<span class="colon">:</span>
</dt>
<dd class="field-odd">
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">bool</span>
</code>
</dd>
<dt class="field-even">
Default
<span class="colon">:</span>
</dt>
<dd class="field-even">
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">true</span>
</code>
</dd>
</dl>
<div class="versionadded">
<p>
<span class="versionmodified added">Added in version 8.4.</span>
</p>
</div>
<p>
Setting this to 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">false</span>
</code>
 will make pytest collect classes/functions from test
files 
<strong>only</strong>
 if they are defined in that file (as opposed to imported there).
</p>
<div class="tab-set docutils container">
<input checked="True" class="tab-input" id="tab-set--2-input--1" name="tab-set--2" type="radio">
<label class="tab-label" for="tab-set--2-input--1">toml</label>
<div class="tab-content docutils container">
<div class="highlight-toml notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
<span class="k">[pytest]</span>
<span class="n">collect_imported_tests</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="o">=</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="kc">false</span>
</pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<input class="tab-input" id="tab-set--2-input--2" name="tab-set--2" type="radio">
<label class="tab-label" for="tab-set--2-input--2">ini</label>
<div class="tab-content docutils container">
<div class="highlight-ini notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
<span class="k">[pytest]</span>
<span class="na">collect_imported_tests</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="o">=</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="s">false</span>
</pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p>pytest traditionally collects classes/functions in the test module namespace even if they are imported from another file.</p>
<p>For example:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
<span class="c1"># contents of src/domain.py</span>
<span class="k">class</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="nc">Testament</span>
<span class="p">:</span> <span class="o">...</span>


<span class="c1"># contents of tests/test_testament.py</span>
<span class="kn">from</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="nn">domain</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">Testament</span>


<span class="k">def</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="nf">test_testament</span>
<span class="p">():</span> <span class="o">...</span>
</pre>
</div>
</div>
<p>
In this scenario, with the default options, pytest will collect the class 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">Testament</span>
</code>
 from 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">tests/test_testament.py</span>
</code>
 because it starts with 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">Test</span>
</code>
, even though in this case it is a production class being imported in the test module namespace.
</p>
<p>
Set 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">collected_imported_tests</span>
</code>
 to 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">false</span>
</code>
 in the configuration file prevents that.
</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std confval">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="confval-consider_namespace_packages">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">consider_namespace_packages</span>
</span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#confval-consider_namespace_packages" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<dl class="field-list">
<dt class="field-odd">
Type
<span class="colon">:</span>
</dt>
<dd class="field-odd">
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">bool</span>
</code>
</dd>
<dt class="field-even">
Default
<span class="colon">:</span>
</dt>
<dd class="field-even">
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">false</span>
</code>
</dd>
</dl>
<p>
Controls if pytest should attempt to identify 
<a class="reference external" href="https://packaging.python.org/en/latest/guides/packaging-namespace-packages">namespace packages</a>

when collecting Python modules.
</p>
<p>
Set to 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">True</span>
</code>
 if the package you are testing is part of a namespace package.
Namespace packages are also supported as 
<a class="reference internal" href="#cmdoption-pyargs">
<code class="xref std std-option docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">--pyargs</span>
</code>
</a>
 target.
</p>
<p>
Only 
<a class="reference external" href="https://packaging.python.org/en/latest/guides/packaging-namespace-packages/#native-namespace-packages">native namespace packages</a>

are supported, with no plans to support 
<a class="reference external" href="https://packaging.python.org/en/latest/guides/packaging-namespace-packages/#legacy-namespace-packages">legacy namespace packages</a>
.
</p>
<p>
For best results when using 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">consider_namespace_packages</span>
</code>
,
pytest needs to be able to import your namespace packages.
This is best achieved by installing the packages in your environment,
most commonly in 
<a class="reference external" href="https://packaging.python.org/en/latest/guides/distributing-packages-using-setuptools/#working-in-development-mode">“editable” mode</a>
.
If you can’t install the packages, consider adding the namespace root paths to 
<a class="reference internal" href="#confval-pythonpath">
<code class="xref std std-confval docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">pythonpath</span>
</code>
</a>
.
</p>
<div class="versionadded">
<p>
<span class="versionmodified added">Added in version 8.1.</span>
</p>
</div>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std confval">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="confval-console_output_style">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">console_output_style</span>
</span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#confval-console_output_style" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<dl class="field-list">
<dt class="field-odd">
Type
<span class="colon">:</span>
</dt>
<dd class="field-odd">
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">str</span>
</code>
</dd>
<dt class="field-even">
Default
<span class="colon">:</span>
</dt>
<dd class="field-even">
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">"progress"</span>
</code>
</dd>
</dl>
<p>Sets the console output style while running tests:</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li>
<p>
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">classic</span>
</code>
: classic pytest output.
</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">progress</span>
</code>
: like classic pytest output, but with a progress indicator.
</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">progress-even-when-capture-no</span>
</code>
: allows the use of the progress indicator even when 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">capture=no</span>
</code>
.
</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">count</span>
</code>
: like progress, but shows progress as the number of tests completed instead of a percent.
</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">times</span>
</code>
: show tests duration.
</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>
You can fallback to 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">classic</span>
</code>
 if you prefer or
the new mode is causing unexpected problems:
</p>
<div class="tab-set docutils container">
<input checked="True" class="tab-input" id="tab-set--3-input--1" name="tab-set--3" type="radio">
<label class="tab-label" for="tab-set--3-input--1">toml</label>
<div class="tab-content docutils container">
<div class="highlight-toml notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
<span class="k">[pytest]</span>
<span class="n">console_output_style</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="o">=</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="s2">"classic"</span>
</pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<input class="tab-input" id="tab-set--3-input--2" name="tab-set--3" type="radio">
<label class="tab-label" for="tab-set--3-input--2">ini</label>
<div class="tab-content docutils container">
<div class="highlight-ini notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
<span class="k">[pytest]</span>
<span class="na">console_output_style</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="o">=</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="s">classic</span>
</pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std confval">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="confval-disable_test_id_escaping_and_forfeit_all_rights_to_community_support">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">disable_test_id_escaping_and_forfeit_all_rights_to_community_support</span>
</span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#confval-disable_test_id_escaping_and_forfeit_all_rights_to_community_support" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<dl class="field-list">
<dt class="field-odd">
Type
<span class="colon">:</span>
</dt>
<dd class="field-odd">
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">bool</span>
</code>
</dd>
<dt class="field-even">
Default
<span class="colon">:</span>
</dt>
<dd class="field-even">
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">false</span>
</code>
</dd>
</dl>
<div class="versionadded">
<p>
<span class="versionmodified added">Added in version 4.4.</span>
</p>
</div>
<p>pytest by default escapes any non-ascii characters used in unicode strings
for the parametrization because it has several downsides.
If however you would like to use unicode strings in parametrization
and see them in the terminal as is (non-escaped), use this option
in your configuration file:</p>
<div class="tab-set docutils container">
<input checked="True" class="tab-input" id="tab-set--4-input--1" name="tab-set--4" type="radio">
<label class="tab-label" for="tab-set--4-input--1">toml</label>
<div class="tab-content docutils container">
<div class="highlight-toml notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
<span class="k">[pytest]</span>
<span class="n">disable_test_id_escaping_and_forfeit_all_rights_to_community_support</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="o">=</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="kc">true</span>
</pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<input class="tab-input" id="tab-set--4-input--2" name="tab-set--4" type="radio">
<label class="tab-label" for="tab-set--4-input--2">ini</label>
<div class="tab-content docutils container">
<div class="highlight-ini notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
<span class="k">[pytest]</span>
<span class="na">disable_test_id_escaping_and_forfeit_all_rights_to_community_support</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="o">=</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="s">true</span>
</pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p>Keep in mind however that this might cause unwanted side effects and
even bugs depending on the OS used and plugins currently installed,
so use it at your own risk.</p>
<p>
See 
<a class="reference internal" href="../how-to/parametrize.html#parametrizemark">
<span class="std std-ref">@pytest.mark.parametrize: parametrizing test functions</span>
</a>
.
</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std confval">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="confval-doctest_encoding">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">doctest_encoding</span>
</span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#confval-doctest_encoding" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<dl class="field-list">
<dt class="field-odd">
Type
<span class="colon">:</span>

<li>

<code class="docutils literal notranslate">

 contents.

</code>
 contents.

: write captured 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">

, 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">stdout</span>
</code>
 and 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">stderr</span>
</code>
 contents.
</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">

: no captured output is written.
</p>
</li>
</ul>

<p>Allow selective auto-indentation of multiline log messages.</p>
<p>
Supports command line option 
<a class="reference internal" href="#cmdoption-log-auto-indent">

<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">log_auto_indent</span> <span class="pre">=</span> <span class="pre">[value]</span>
</code>
 to set the
auto-indentation behavior for all logging.
</p>
<dl class="simple">

<code class="docutils literal notranslate">

</code>

</dt>
<dd>
<ul class="simple">
<li>
<p>“True” or “On” - Dynamically auto-indent multiline log messages</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>“False” or “Off” or “0” - Do not auto-indent multiline log messages</p>
</li>
<li>

</li>
</ul>
</dd>
</dl>

</pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p>
Supports passing kwarg 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">extra={"auto_indent":</span> <span class="pre">[value]}</span>
</code>
 to
calls to 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">logging.log()</span>
</code>
 to specify auto-indentation behavior for
a specific entry in the log. 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">extra</span>
</code>
 kwarg overrides the value specified
on the command line or in the config.
</p>

<dl class="std confval">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="confval-norecursedirs">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">norecursedirs</span>
</span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#confval-norecursedirs" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<dl class="field-list">
<dt class="field-odd">
Type
<span class="colon">:</span>
</dt>
<dd class="field-odd">
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">list[str]</span>
</code>
</dd>
<dt class="field-even">
Default
<span class="colon">:</span>
</dt>
<dd class="field-even">
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">["*.egg",</span> <span class="pre">".*",</span> <span class="pre">"_darcs",</span> <span class="pre">"build",</span> <span class="pre">"CVS",</span> <span class="pre">"dist",</span> <span class="pre">"node_modules",</span> <span class="pre">"venv",</span> <span class="pre">"{arch}"]</span>
</code>
</dd>
</dl>
<p>Set the directory basename patterns to avoid when recursing
for test discovery.  The individual (fnmatch-style) patterns are
applied to the basename of a directory to decide if to recurse into it.
Pattern matching characters:</p>
<div class="highlight-default notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
*       matches everything
?       matches any single character
[seq]   matches any character in seq
[!seq]  matches any char not in seq

</pre>
</div>
</div>
<p>
Setting a 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">norecursedirs</span>
</code>
 replaces the default.  Here is an example of
how to avoid certain directories:
</p>
<div class="tab-set docutils container">
<input checked="True" class="tab-input" id="tab-set--31-input--1" name="tab-set--31" type="radio">
<label class="tab-label" for="tab-set--31-input--1">toml</label>
<div class="tab-content docutils container">
<div class="highlight-toml notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
<span class="k">[pytest]</span>
<span class="n">norecursedirs</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="o">=</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="p">[</span>
<span class="s2">".svn"</span>
<span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="s2">"_build"</span>
<span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="s2">"tmp*"</span>
<span class="p">]</span>
</pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<input class="tab-input" id="tab-set--31-input--2" name="tab-set--31" type="radio">
<label class="tab-label" for="tab-set--31-input--2">ini</label>
<div class="tab-content docutils container">
<div class="highlight-ini notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
<span class="k">[pytest]</span>
<span class="na">norecursedirs</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="o">=</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="s">.svn _build tmp*</span>
</pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p>
This would tell 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">pytest</span>
</code>
 to not look into typical subversion or
sphinx-build directories or into any 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">tmp</span>
</code>
 prefixed directory.
</p>
<p>
Additionally, 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">pytest</span>
</code>
 will attempt to intelligently identify and ignore
a virtualenv.  Any directory deemed to be the root of a virtual environment
will not be considered during test collection unless

<a class="reference internal" href="#cmdoption-collect-in-virtualenv">
<code class="xref std std-option docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">--collect-in-virtualenv</span>
</code>
</a>
 is given.  Note also that 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">norecursedirs</span>
</code>

takes precedence over 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">--collect-in-virtualenv</span>
</code>
; e.g. if you intend to
run tests in a virtualenv with a base directory that matches 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">'.*'</span>
</code>
 you

<em>must</em>
 override 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">norecursedirs</span>
</code>
 in addition to using the

<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">--collect-in-virtualenv</span>
</code>
 flag.
</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std confval">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="confval-python_classes">

<p>

 as a test collection.  Here is an example of how

:

<div class="tab-set docutils container">
<input checked="True" class="tab-input" id="tab-set--32-input--1" name="tab-set--32" type="radio">
<label class="tab-label" for="tab-set--32-input--1">toml</label>
<div class="tab-content docutils container">
<div class="highlight-toml notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
<span class="k">[pytest]</span>
<span class="n">python_classes</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="o">=</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="p">[</span>
<span class="s2">"*Suite"</span>
<span class="p">]</span>
</pre>

</div>
</div>
<input class="tab-input" id="tab-set--32-input--2" name="tab-set--32" type="radio">

<div class="tab-content docutils container">
<div class="highlight-ini notranslate">

<pre><span></span>
<span class="k">[pytest]</span>
<span class="na">python_classes</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="o">=</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="s">*Suite</span>
</pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p>
Note that 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">unittest.TestCase</span>
</code>
 derived classes are always collected
regardless of this option, as 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">unittest</span>
</code>
’s own collection framework is used
to collect those tests.
</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<p>
If set to

<span class="pre">true</span>
</code>
, enable “strict mode”, which enables the following options:
</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li>

<li>

<code class="xref std std-confval docutils literal notranslate">

</a>
</p>
</li>
<li>

<a class="reference internal" href="#confval-strict_xfail">

</code>
</a>
</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>Plugins may also enable their own strictness options.</p>
<p>
If you explicitly set an individual strictness option, it takes precedence over

<p>

</p>
<p>
If not set, pytest automatically handles this by adding 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">0</span>
</code>
, 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">1</span>
</code>
, … to duplicate IDs,
making them unique.
</p>
<div class="tab-set docutils container">
<input checked="True" class="tab-input" id="tab-set--40-input--1" name="tab-set--40" type="radio">
<label class="tab-label" for="tab-set--40-input--1">toml</label>

<div class="highlight">

<span class="k">[pytest]</span>
<span class="n">strict_parametrization_ids</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="o">=</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="kc">true</span>
</pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<input class="tab-input" id="tab-set--40-input--2" name="tab-set--40" type="radio">
<label class="tab-label" for="tab-set--40-input--2">ini</label>
<div class="tab-content docutils container">
<div class="highlight-ini notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
<span class="k">[pytest]</span>
<span class="na">strict_parametrization_ids</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="o">=</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="s">true</span>
</pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p>
You can also enable this option via the 
<a class="reference internal" href="#confval-strict">
<code class="xref std std-confval docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">strict</span>
</code>
</a>
 option.
</p>
<p>For example,</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
<span class="kn">import</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="nn">pytest</span>


<span class="nd">@pytest</span>
<span class="o">.</span>
<span class="n">mark</span>
<span class="o">.</span>
<span class="n">parametrize</span>
<span class="p">(</span>
<span class="s2">"letter"</span>
<span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">[</span>
<span class="s2">"a"</span>
<span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"a"</span>
<span class="p">])</span>
<span class="k">def</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="nf">test_letter_is_ascii</span>
<span class="p">(</span>
<span class="n">letter</span>
<span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="k">assert</span> <span class="n">letter</span>
<span class="o">.</span>
<span class="n">isascii</span>
<span class="p">()</span>
</pre>
</div>
</div>
<p>will emit an error because both cases (parameter sets) have the same auto-generated ID “a”.</p>
<p>To fix the error, if you decide to keep the duplicates, explicitly assign unique IDs:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
<span class="kn">import</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="nn">pytest</span>


<span class="nd">@pytest</span>
<span class="o">.</span>
<span class="n">mark</span>
<span class="o">.</span>
<span class="n">parametrize</span>
<span class="p">(</span>
<span class="s2">"letter"</span>
<span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">[</span>
<span class="s2">"a"</span>
<span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"a"</span>
<span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">ids</span>
<span class="o">=</span>
<span class="p">[</span>
<span class="s2">"a0"</span>
<span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"a1"</span>
<span class="p">])</span>
<span class="k">def</span>
<span class="w"> </span>
<span class="nf">test_letter_is_ascii</span>
<span class="p">(</span>
<span class="n">letter</span>
<span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="k">assert</span> <span class="n">letter</span>
<span class="o">.</span>
<span class="n">isascii</span>
<span class="p">()</span>
</pre>
</div>
</div>
<p>
See 
<a class="reference internal" href="#pytest.Metafunc.parametrize" title="pytest.Metafunc.parametrize">
<code class="xref py py-func docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">parametrize</span>
</code>
</a>
 and 
<a class="reference internal" href="#pytest.param" title="pytest.param">
<code class="xref py py-func docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">pytest.param()</span>
</code>
</a>
 for other ways to set IDs.
</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<section id="command-line-flags">
<span id="id54"></span>
<h2>
Command-line Flags
<a class="headerlink" href="#command-line-flags" title="Link to this heading">¶</a>
</h2>
<p>This section documents all command-line options provided by pytest’s core plugins.</p>
<div class="admonition note">
<p class="admonition-title">
Note
</p>
<p>
External plugins can add their own command-line options.
This reference documents only the options from pytest’s core plugins.
To see all available options including those from installed plugins, run 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">pytest</span> <span class="pre">--help</span>
</code>
.
</p>
</div>
<section id="test-selection">
<h3>
Test Selection
<a class="headerlink" href="#test-selection" title="Link to this heading">¶</a>
</h3>
<dl class="std option">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="cmdoption-k">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">-k</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"> <span class="pre">EXPRESSION</span>
</span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#cmdoption-k" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>Only run tests which match the given substring expression.
An expression is a Python evaluable expression where all names are substring-matched against test names and their parent classes.</p>
<p>Examples:</p>
<div class="highlight-default notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
<span class="n">pytest</span> <span class="o">-</span>
<span class="n">k</span> <span class="s2">"test_method or test_other"</span>  <span class="c1"># matches names containing 'test_method' OR 'test_other'</span>
<span class="n">pytest</span> <span class="o">-</span>
<span class="n">k</span> <span class="s2">"not test_method"</span>            <span class="c1"># matches names NOT containing 'test_method'</span>
<span class="n">pytest</span> <span class="o">-</span>
<span class="n">k</span> <span class="s2">"not test_method and not test_other"</span>  <span class="c1"># excludes both</span>
</pre>
</div>
</div>
<p>
The matching is case-insensitive.
Keywords are also matched to classes and functions containing extra names in their 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">extra_keyword_matches</span>
</code>
 set.
</p>
<p>
See 
<a class="reference internal" href="../how-to/usage.html#select-tests">
<span class="std std-ref">Specifying which tests to run</span>
</a>
 for more information and examples.
</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std option">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="cmdoption-m">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">-m</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"> <span class="pre">MARKEXPR</span>
</span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#cmdoption-m" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>
Only run tests matching given mark expression.
Supports 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">and</span>
</code>
, 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">or</span>
</code>
, and 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">not</span>
</code>
 operators.
</p>
<p>Examples:</p>
<div class="highlight-default notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
<span class="n">pytest</span> <span class="o">-</span>
<span class="n">m</span> <span class="n">slow</span>                  <span class="c1"># run tests marked with @pytest.mark.slow</span>
<span class="n">pytest</span> <span class="o">-</span>
<span class="n">m</span> <span class="s2">"not slow"</span>            <span class="c1"># run tests NOT marked slow</span>
<span class="n">pytest</span> <span class="o">-</span>
<span class="n">m</span> <span class="s2">"mark1 and not mark2"</span> <span class="c1"># run tests marked mark1 but not mark2</span>
</pre>
</div>
</div>
<p>
See 
<a class="reference internal" href="../how-to/mark.html#mark">
<span class="std std-ref">How to mark test functions with attributes</span>
</a>
 for more information on markers.
</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std option">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="cmdoption-markers">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">--markers</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"></span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#cmdoption-markers" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>Show all available markers (builtin, plugin, and per-project markers defined in configuration).</p>
</dd>
</dl>

</section>
<section id="test-execution-control">
<h3>
Test Execution Control
<a class="headerlink" href="#test-execution-control" title="Link to this heading">¶</a>
</h3>
<dl class="std option">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="cmdoption-x">
<span id="cmdoption-exitfirst"></span>
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">-x</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"></span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname">
<span class="pre">,</span> </span>
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">--exitfirst</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"></span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#cmdoption-x" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>Exit instantly on first error or failed test.</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std option">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="cmdoption-maxfail">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">--maxfail</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname">
<span class="pre">=NUM</span>
</span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#cmdoption-maxfail" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>
Exit after first 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">num</span>
</code>
 failures or errors.
Useful for CI environments where you want to fail fast but see a few failures.
</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std option">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="cmdoption-last-failed">
<span id="cmdoption-lf"></span>
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">--last-failed</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"></span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname">
<span class="pre">,</span> </span>
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">--lf</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"></span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#cmdoption-last-failed" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>
Rerun only the tests that failed at the last run.
If no tests failed (or no cached data exists), all tests are run.
See also 
<a class="reference internal" href="#confval-cache_dir">
<code class="xref std std-confval docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">cache_dir</span>
</code>
</a>
 and 
<a class="reference internal" href="../how-to/cache.html#cache">
<span class="std std-ref">How to re-run failed tests and maintain state between test runs</span>
</a>
.
</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std option">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="cmdoption-failed-first">
<span id="cmdoption-ff"></span>
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">--failed-first</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"></span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname">
<span class="pre">,</span> </span>
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">--ff</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"></span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#cmdoption-failed-first" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>Run all tests, but run the last failures first.
This may re-order tests and thus lead to repeated fixture setup/teardown.</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std option">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="cmdoption-new-first">
<span id="cmdoption-nf"></span>
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">--new-first</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"></span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname">
<span class="pre">,</span> </span>
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">--nf</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"></span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#cmdoption-new-first" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>Run tests from new files first, then the rest of the tests sorted by file modification time.</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std option">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="cmdoption-stepwise">
<span id="cmdoption-sw"></span>
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">--stepwise</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"></span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname">
<span class="pre">,</span> </span>
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">--sw</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"></span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#cmdoption-stepwise" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>Exit on test failure and continue from last failing test next time.
Useful for fixing multiple test failures one at a time.</p>
<p>
See 
<a class="reference internal" href="../how-to/cache.html#cache-stepwise">
<span class="std std-ref">Stepwise</span>
</a>
 for more information.
</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std option">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="cmdoption-stepwise-skip">
<span id="cmdoption-sw-skip"></span>
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">--stepwise-skip</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"></span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname">
<span class="pre">,</span> </span>
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">--sw-skip</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"></span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#cmdoption-stepwise-skip" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>
Ignore the first failing test but stop on the next failing test.
Implicitly enables 
<a class="reference internal" href="#cmdoption-stepwise">
<code class="xref std std-option docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">--stepwise</span>
</code>
</a>
.
</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std option">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="cmdoption-stepwise-reset">
<span id="cmdoption-sw-reset"></span>
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">--stepwise-reset</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"></span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname">
<span class="pre">,</span> </span>
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">--sw-reset</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"></span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#cmdoption-stepwise-reset" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>
Resets stepwise state, restarting the stepwise workflow.
Implicitly enables 
<a class="reference internal" href="#cmdoption-stepwise">
<code class="xref std std-option docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">--stepwise</span>
</code>
</a>
.
</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std option">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="cmdoption-last-failed-no-failures">
<span id="cmdoption-lfnf"></span>
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">--last-failed-no-failures</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"></span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname">
<span class="pre">,</span> </span>
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">--lfnf</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"></span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#cmdoption-last-failed-no-failures" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>
With 
<a class="reference internal" href="#cmdoption-last-failed">
<code class="xref std std-option docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">--last-failed</span>
</code>
</a>
, determines whether to execute tests when there are no previously known failures or when no cached 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">lastfailed</span>
</code>
 data was found.
</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li>
<p>
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">all</span>
</code>
 (default): runs the full test suite again
</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">none</span>
</code>
: just emits a message about no known failures and exits successfully
</p>
</li>
</ul>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std option">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="cmdoption-runxfail">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">--runxfail</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"></span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#cmdoption-runxfail" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>
Report the results of xfail tests as if they were not marked.
Useful for debugging xfailed tests.
See 
<a class="reference internal" href="../how-to/skipping.html#xfail">
<span class="std std-ref">XFail: mark test functions as expected to fail</span>
</a>
.
</p>
</dd>
</dl>

</section>
<section id="collection">
<h3>
Collection
<a class="headerlink" href="#collection" title="Link to this heading">¶</a>
</h3>
<dl class="std option">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="cmdoption-collect-only">
<span id="cmdoption-co"></span>
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">--collect-only</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"></span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname">
<span class="pre">,</span> </span>
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">--co</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"></span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#cmdoption-collect-only" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>Only collect tests, don’t execute them.
Shows which tests would be collected and run.</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std option">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="cmdoption-pyargs">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">--pyargs</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"></span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#cmdoption-pyargs" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>Try to interpret all arguments as Python packages.
Useful for running tests of installed packages:</p>
<div class="highlight-default notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
<span class="n">pytest</span> <span class="o">--</span>
<span class="n">pyargs</span> <span class="n">pkg</span>
<span class="o">.</span>
<span class="n">testing</span>
</pre>
</div>
</div>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std option">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="cmdoption-ignore">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">--ignore</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname">
<span class="pre">=PATH</span>
</span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#cmdoption-ignore" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>Ignore path during collection (multi-allowed).
Can be specified multiple times.</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std option">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="cmdoption-ignore-glob">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">--ignore-glob</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname">
<span class="pre">=PATTERN</span>
</span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#cmdoption-ignore-glob" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>Ignore path pattern during collection (multi-allowed).
Supports glob patterns.</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std option">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="cmdoption-deselect">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">--deselect</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname">
<span class="pre">=NODEID_PREFIX</span>
</span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#cmdoption-deselect" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>Deselect item (via node id prefix) during collection (multi-allowed).</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std option">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="cmdoption-confcutdir">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">--confcutdir</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname">
<span class="pre">=DIR</span>
</span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#cmdoption-confcutdir" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>
Only load 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">conftest.py</span>
</code>
 files relative to specified directory.
</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std option">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="cmdoption-noconftest">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">--noconftest</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"></span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#cmdoption-noconftest" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>
Don’t load any 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">conftest.py</span>
</code>
 files.
</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std option">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="cmdoption-keep-duplicates">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">--keep-duplicates</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"></span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#cmdoption-keep-duplicates" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>Keep duplicate tests. By default, pytest removes duplicate test items.</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std option">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="cmdoption-collect-in-virtualenv">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">--collect-in-virtualenv</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"></span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#cmdoption-collect-in-virtualenv" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>Don’t ignore tests in a local virtualenv directory.
By default, pytest skips tests in virtualenv directories.</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std option">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="cmdoption-continue-on-collection-errors">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">--continue-on-collection-errors</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"></span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#cmdoption-continue-on-collection-errors" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>Force test execution even if collection errors occur.</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std option">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="cmdoption-import-mode">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">--import-mode</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"></span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#cmdoption-import-mode" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>Prepend/append to sys.path when importing test modules and conftest files.</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li>
<p>
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">prepend</span>
</code>
 (default): prepend to sys.path
</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">append</span>
</code>
: append to sys.path
</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">importlib</span>
</code>
: use importlib to import test modules
</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>
See 
<a class="reference internal" href="../explanation/pythonpath.html#pythonpath">
<span class="std std-ref">pytest import mechanisms and sys.path/PYTHONPATH</span>
</a>
 for more information.
</p>
</dd>
</dl>

</section>
<section id="id55">
<h3>
Fixtures
<a class="headerlink" href="#id55" title="Link to this heading">¶</a>
</h3>
<dl class="std option">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="cmdoption-fixtures">
<span id="cmdoption-funcargs"></span>
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">--fixtures</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"></span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname">
<span class="pre">,</span> </span>
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">--funcargs</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"></span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#cmdoption-fixtures" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>
Show available fixtures, sorted by plugin appearance.
Fixtures with leading 
<code class="docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">_</span>
</code>
 are only shown with 
<a class="reference internal" href="#cmdoption-v">
<code class="xref std std-option docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">--verbose</span>
</code>
</a>
.
</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std option">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="cmdoption-fixtures-per-test">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">--fixtures-per-test</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"></span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#cmdoption-fixtures-per-test" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>Show fixtures per test.</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std option">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="cmdoption-setup-only">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">--setup-only</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"></span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#cmdoption-setup-only" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>
Only setup fixtures, do not execute tests.
See 
<a class="reference internal" href="../how-to/fixtures.html#how-to-fixtures">
<span class="std std-ref">How to use fixtures</span>
</a>
.
</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std option">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="cmdoption-setup-show">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">--setup-show</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"></span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#cmdoption-setup-show" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>Show setup of fixtures while executing tests.</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std option">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="cmdoption-setup-plan">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">--setup-plan</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"></span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#cmdoption-setup-plan" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>Show what fixtures and tests would be executed but don’t execute anything.</p>
</dd>
</dl>

</section>
<section id="debugging">
<h3>
Debugging
<a class="headerlink" href="#debugging" title="Link to this heading">¶</a>
</h3>
<dl class="std option">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="cmdoption-pdb">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">--pdb</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"></span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#cmdoption-pdb" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>
Start the interactive Python debugger on errors or KeyboardInterrupt.
See 
<a class="reference internal" href="../how-to/failures.html#pdb-option">
<span class="std std-ref">Using python:library/pdb with pytest</span>
</a>
.
</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std option">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="cmdoption-pdbcls">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">--pdbcls</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname">
<span class="pre">=MODULENAME:CLASSNAME</span>
</span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#cmdoption-pdbcls" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>
Specify a custom interactive Python debugger for use with 
<a class="reference internal" href="#cmdoption-pdb">
<code class="xref std std-option docutils literal notranslate">
<span class="pre">--pdb</span>
</code>
</a>
.
</p>
<p>Example:</p>
<div class="highlight-default notranslate">
<div class="highlight">
<pre><span></span>
<span class="n">pytest</span> <span class="o">--</span>
<span class="n">pdbcls</span>
<span class="o">=</span>
<span class="n">IPython</span>
<span class="o">.</span>
<span class="n">terminal</span>
<span class="o">.</span>
<span class="n">debugger</span>
<span class="p">:</span>
<span class="n">TerminalPdb</span>
</pre>
</div>
</div>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std option">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="cmdoption-trace">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">--trace</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"></span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#cmdoption-trace" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>Immediately break when running each test.</p>
<p>
See 
<a class="reference internal" href="../how-to/failures.html#trace-option">
<span class="std std-ref">Dropping to pdb at the start of a test</span>
</a>
 for more information.
</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std option">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="cmdoption-full-trace">
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">--full-trace</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"></span>
<a class="headerlink" href="#cmdoption-full-trace" title="Link to this definition">¶</a>
</dt>
<dd>
<p>Don’t cut any tracebacks (default is to cut).</p>
<p>
See 
<a class="reference internal" href="../how-to/output.html#how-to-modifying-python-tb-printing">
<span class="std std-ref">Modifying Python traceback printing</span>
</a>
 for more information.
</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<dl class="std option">
<dt class="sig sig-object std" id="cmdoption-debug">
<span id="cmdoption-debug"></span>
<span class="sig-name descname">
<span class="pre">--debug</span>
</span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname"></span>
<span class="sig-prename descclassname">
<span class="pre">,</span> </span>
<span class="sig-name descname">

Default file name if not specified:

.
